## 🔥 Python直接可跑代码

```python
import requests
import pandas as pd

def get_stock_data(code="600398", klt=101, fqt=1):
    url = "http://push2his.eastmoney.com/api/qt/stock/kline/get"

    params = {
        "secid": f"1.{code}",
        "fields1": "f1,f2,f3,f4,f5,f6",
        "fields2": "f51,f52,f53,f54,f55,f56,f57,f58",
        "klt": klt,   # 101=日K
        "fqt": fqt,   # 复权
        "beg": 0,
        "end": 20500000,
    }

    res = requests.get(url, params=params)
    data = res.json()

    klines = data["data"]["klines"]

    result = []
    for k in klines:
        parts = k.split(",")
        result.append(parts)

    df = pd.DataFrame(result, columns=[
        "date", "open", "close", "high", "low", "volume", "amount", "change_percent", "change_amount", "turnover"
    ])

    df.to_csv("hailanzhijia.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    return df

df = get_stock_data()
print(df.tail())
```
